sources.title: llm jp 4 32b a3b thinking — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A Japanese-language focused model from llm-jp that incorporates a thinking or reasoning step before producing responses. With 32 billion total parameters but only 3 billion active at a time, it uses a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture that keeps inference costs lower than its full parameter count suggests. Its open-weight nature means it can be run locally and inspected freely.

sources.title: GitHub - llm-jp/llm-jp-4-cookbook: Example scripts for LLM-jp-4 models
sources.snippet: Using llm-jp-4-*-instruct and llm-jp-4-*-thinking models LLM-jp-4 models with the suffix -instruct or -thinking are fine-tuned models for chatbot applications. -instruct models are tuned for responding without reasoning, while -thinking models work with a specific reasoning effort (low, medium, or high).
